author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Google Flow step by step. In this beginner-friendly tutorial, I'll show you how to create AI-generated videos with Google's new AI filmmaking tool. You'll learn how to brainstorm ideas, generate storyboards, create cinematic video clips, build consistent AI characters, edit scenes, and even transform existing videos using AI. We'll build a complete commercial from scratch so you can see the entire workflow from idea to finished video.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Get started with Google Flow: https://flow.google

⌚ TIMESTAMPS
0:00 - Introduction
0:28 - Create a new project
0:49 - Build a storyboard
3:29 - Generate AI video clips
4:31 - Edit your scene
6:36 - Create consistent AI characters
8:30 - Transform existing videos with AI
9:03 - Wrap up
